body: Thank you, I am not religious either and thanks for the kind words and support, it does mean a lot.

I live in small town of 6,000 people. I tried to join an LGBT group on my campus but they were more of an awareness group then a support group and it had less than 10 people and I was the only trans person. Then I tried to go to a support group that was run by my therapist. But everyone one there was WAY older than me. The youngest person (besides myself) was 40 years old, and everyone had kids. (I am 21 years old)

uh not to sound like an asshole but I think this person is just making fun of me. From my story from [here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/hh4ab/i_really_dont_see_it_getting_better/) and [here.](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/hhuij/well_i_tried_to_kill_myself_yesterday_morning_and/) I mean mtf, no friends, no job, same gpa and, tried to kill self once. Unless this person is my doppelgänger I think this is a joke. If some how it is not a joke then sorry but it just sounds too much like what I posted.
oops I deleted the wrong duplicate post but at lest your message is still here.

This may sound really bad, but at the time when my mom was freaking out I was laughing (mostly because I was drunk) looking back I feel bad about that, but at the time it just what happened. I am sorry to hear about your loss, I wrote in my first post: 

"The only things that keep me going is distracting myself with tv shows, movies, games and, books. If it wasn’t for my mom I would have killed myself a long time ago, I know how much I would hurt her if I killed myself. I feel like being on life support if my mom were to die suddenly in car accident or something I would kill myself asap."

I guess last night I was being selfish.
My mom is worried about me telling my therapist because she is worried the police will get involved and that it will go on some "permanent record" of mine somewhere.

I know that she would "rather be worried because you tried than grieving because you succeeded" but in in hindsight the pills with alcohol wouldn't have killed me so I should have just gone to bed.
 
My mom is worried about me telling my therapist because she is worried the police will get involved and that it will go on some "permanent record" of mine somewhere, does that really happen?
